hypothesised_pattern: The target is pushed up when x2 and x5 share a sign and |x4| is large, and pushed down when x2 and x5 have opposite signs and x4 is near zero, and the base model does not reproduce either effect.
rationale: The four positive-residual rows (targets 0.54-0.96) all have x2*x5 > 0 (about 1.13, 0.75, 0.48, 0.57) and |x4| of at least 1.16 (2.020, 1.158, -2.630, 2.437). The six negative-residual rows (targets 0.0-0.36) all have x2*x5 < 0 (about -0.7 to -5.4) and |x4| of at most 0.36; row 1, with the most extreme product (-1.362*3.932), drops about 0.26 below the base prediction.
